_rules: A thing with `neededBy: []` is a RECORD, not a reference — it appears in one scene only, so nothing carries it and it never rides a card. A card that CHAINS off the clip before it already carries that clip's room and clothes, so it is never listed (that is why sj-c asks for neither the bedroom nor the wardrobe). `line` is what goes in the header, filled with the slot the builder assigns: a reference is named by its slot and never described.
